metadata.title: Audited evidence for the maize weather-prediction manuscript
metadata.purpose: Static manuscript figures/tables and independent aggregate verification; no new model training or bootstrap calculation
metadata.difference_sign: candidate minus reference; negative RMSE difference is better
metadata.primary_estimand: Equal mean of five annual environment-equal RMSE values; not pooled row RMSE and not environment-year-equal RMSE
metadata.interval_source: Frozen independently audited CSV endpoints, 2,000 draws; copied unchanged, not recalculated

rolling_v1.arithmetic_source: Independent NumPy residual arithmetic, tie-group ranking, explicit environment bootstrap and matrix-form year/site cluster bootstrap; no production scorer imports.

segmented_v1.arithmetic_source: Independent rolling validator residual/tie/bootstrap arithmetic plus independently implemented clipped calendar-block weather arithmetic.

design.candidate_selection: Two candidates per model/window selected by preceding-year environment-equal RMSE; independent choices per representation

totals.note: Counts refer to one configuration, not totals multiplied by model/window/representation. Site codes are proxies, not independently verified locations.

official_provenance_followup.scope: Follow-up for the four previously incomplete official-source comparisons; not a replacement for the historical three-file metadata/template receipt.
official_provenance_followup.method: Public official HTTPS byte ranges, exact Content-Range validation, full size and SHA-256, csv-reader ordered header/key/cell equality; genotype <Numeric> declaration stripped and <Marker> identifier renamed to mirror Geno.

environment_metrics_export_scope: W0 and W120 including both simple baselines, both representations; full 4,386-row source verified before filtering

sufficient_windows.criterion: >=2% W120 vs W0 RMSE improvement, paired 95% CI strictly below zero, then >=90% point-estimate gain retention; not proof of noninferiority or a universal agronomic rule

verification.scope: All 170 annual configuration records from 4,386 environment-configuration records; all 36 overall cross-year contrasts and year-direction counts; cohort/subgroup consistency. No raw-residual replay or bootstrap recomputation in this collector; those have separate existing audits.

caveats: The rolling extension was specified after inspecting the original 2024 result; the segmented hypothesis was chosen after inspecting cumulative results. These are exploratory retrospective backtests, not independently blinded confirmation.
W0 contains 100 training-fitted SNP principal components, static geographic/planting covariates and site encoding; a small weather increment does not mean weather is agriculturally unimportant.
Weather is observed retrospective information within each post-planting horizon, not a forecast available at planting. Real-time release latency was not tested.
Thirty-day blocks are calendar windows, not observed phenological stages. Replacement changes feature dimension and model regularization/subsampling, not only temporal resolution.

Five years, overlapping training histories, site-code proxies and unadjusted multiple comparisons limit uncertainty interpretation. Bootstrap intervals are conditional sensitivity intervals excluding refitting and selection uncertainty.
Cohort eligibility requires complete calendar coverage and observed valid targets. No claim applies to all released plots, all farms, national yield, or missing-target observations.
Seen/unseen subgroup cuts are descriptive. Unseen site codes occur in only two years and three environment-years; no explicit geographic holdout or external agricultural validation was run.
The engineering screen and sufficient-window rule are project-specific operational criteria, not published agronomic laws or noninferiority tests.
Internal audit counts are integrity checks, not independent scientific experiments or a measure of publication-level novelty.
GBLUP/RKHS, explicit genotype-by-weather models, measured-phenology alignment, tuning-budget sensitivity and prospective external validation are not part of these completed experiments.
